verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Marketing Emails API for creating and retrieving emails, plus aggregate post-send statistics per email or set of emails. Nothing shows a per-contact view of sent, opened, or clicked events through the API. Email-level statistics are an adjacent capability and do not deliver per-person engagement history.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
